tagline: Modern time tracking and project management platform

what_it_does.summary:
Luum Fresh is a comprehensive time tracking and project management application designed for modern teams. It provides real-time visibility into project progress, resource allocation, and time utilization across multiple projects and team members.

The application combines intuitive time entry interfaces with powerful analytics and reporting capabilities. Users can track time against specific projects and tasks, view burndown charts, manage team capacity, and generate detailed reports for billing and productivity analysis. The platform supports multiple workspaces, custom project hierarchies, and integrates with popular development tools.

Built with a focus on user experience and performance, Luum Fresh offers both web and mobile interfaces, real-time synchronization across devices, and offline capabilities for time tracking on the go. The architecture emphasizes scalability, data consistency, and responsive user interactions.
key_points: Real-time time tracking with offline support
Team capacity planning and resource allocation
Integration with development tools and APIs

components.name: Frontend Application
components.purpose: User interface for time tracking, project management, and analytics visualization

components.name: Backend API Server
components.purpose: RESTful API handling business logic, authentication, and data operations

components.name: Real-time Services
components.purpose: WebSocket connections for live updates and real-time collaboration features

components.name: Database Layer
components.purpose: Relational data storage for projects, time entries, users, and analytics

components.name: Authentication Service
components.purpose: User authentication, authorization, and session management

components.name: Analytics Engine
components.purpose: Data aggregation, report generation, and statistical analysis

relationships: Frontend communicates with Backend API via REST endpoints and WebSocket connections
Backend API validates requests and coordinates with Database Layer and Real-time Services
Real-time Services use Redis pub/sub for broadcasting updates to connected clients
Analytics Engine processes data from PostgreSQL and generates reports on demand
Authentication Service issues JWT tokens verified by all backend services

capabilities.name: Time Tracking
capabilities.description: Start/stop timers, manual time entry, time editing, and bulk operations with offline support

capabilities.name: Project Management
capabilities.description: Create projects, define tasks, set budgets, manage milestones, and track progress

capabilities.name: Team Collaboration
capabilities.description: Real-time updates, shared workspaces, team calendars, and activity feeds

capabilities.name: Analytics & Reporting
capabilities.description: Customizable dashboards, time reports, project analytics, capacity planning, and export capabilities

capabilities.name: API Integration
capabilities.description: RESTful API, webhooks, OAuth integrations with third-party tools (Jira, GitHub, Slack)

capabilities.name: Mobile Support
capabilities.description: Responsive web interface and native mobile apps for iOS and Android

capabilities.name: Billing & Invoicing
capabilities.description: Generate invoices from tracked time, configurable billing rates, and client management

capabilities.name: Resource Planning
capabilities.description: Team capacity visualization, workload balancing, and availability tracking

quick_insights.insight: Well-structured 3-tier architecture with clear separation of concerns
3 medium-severity vulnerabilities in dependencies - update recommended
Real-time layer using efficient Redis pub/sub pattern
Test coverage at 78.5% - consider increasing to 85%+
65% of public APIs documented - improve inline documentation
High code quality score (8.2/10) with consistent style

recommended_next_steps.action: Update dependencies to resolve 3 security vulnerabilities
Increase test coverage from 78.5% to 85%+ for critical paths
Add comprehensive API documentation for all public endpoints
Refactor analytics engine to reduce technical debt by ~40 hours
